documents.title: CU Committee Report: Generative Artificial Intelligence for Education and Pedagogy
documents.stance_why: The report sets no single rule; it says 'we propose a flexible framework in which instructors can choose to prohibit, to allow with attribution, or to encourage GAI use', and asks administrators to say 'individual faculty have authority to determine' this. Three named options, decided by instructors, so delegates with tiers.
documents.summary: Spring 2023 committee report recommending a framework where each instructor prohibits, allows with attribution, or encourages GAI, with notes on integrity, privacy, equity, instructor use and administrative follow-up. It carries a programming section recommending GAI as a tutor in advanced courses but not as sole creator of code.
